title: Kiritani Haruka — Perfect Premonition〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Phew...
We're finally moving in sync now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I think we've gotten the hang of our new way of moving front to back and side to side!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yay...!
After spending so much time practicing it too...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Especially since we kept running into each other in the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Practice makes perfect, no?
The more we try, the better we get.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But this seems like a good time to take a quick break.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, let's take a rest.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (After this, we can do another run with that formation we just did and...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haaruukaa♪
KAITO said we could have these drinks! Here!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks, Rin.
I'll be sure to thank KAITO later as well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You got it! Oh, KAITO was also asking about your new song.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I can't wait to hear what it's like either♪ But you said it might not be ready for a while, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. However, we know what kind of song we want it to be and should be receiving a demo of it soon.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Cool! That's so exciting♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It is. On top of looking forward to hearing it, the person writing it has apparently been a fan of mine for a very long time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really...?!
Oh, can you tell me more about them?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Sure.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She felt hope because of one of your ASRUN songs...? That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori and the others reminded me that I still had hope to give, and our real-life event only helped reiterate that fact...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hasegawa's story showed me that I actually reached someone, and I'm really glad that I put in the effort to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: After doing something I can never fix or take back too...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh... Are you talking about your groupmate? The one that lost her voice...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes...
Her name's Mai...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When Mai fell into a slump and couldn't sing, I...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mai, tomorrow will always be a better day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hold on to hope and keep working hard, and I'm sure things will get better.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mai was already hard-working to begin with, and I ended up adding fuel to the fire...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As a result, she overworked herself and lost her voice...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wish I said something different that time, and I've gone over that conversation in my head more times than I can remember.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But the past can be neither changed nor erased... Which means I have to keep carrying this pain and regret.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And yet...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now, we have smiles on our faces.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mai's trying to recapture her shine by performing in a new show.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's why I also want to keep spreading hope as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because this hope isn't going to spread itself.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You really are amazing, Haruka.
So strong and earnest!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm not strong at all.
I wouldn't be performing on stage if it weren't for Minori and the others.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not only that, I feel the need to discuss what's going through my mind with others from time to time like this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Kind of pathetic, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, that's not true!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna know lots more about you, Haruka! The good and bad!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This SEKAI and I were born out of your feelings, right? And I may be wrong here, but...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I have a feeling we're all gonna learn a lot about ourselves by getting to know each other better.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ourselves?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Like what kinds of songs we want to sing, what kinds of shows we want to do and what sorts of feelings we want to project!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's why I think it's important for you to talk to us like you're talking to yourself.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
All the good and the bad.
The fun and not-so-fun things in life too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see... As if I'm speaking to myself...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, I might have to ask you to do this again for me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, anytime♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Rin.
